While revenue remained under pressure in a challenging market, the Company delivered a Profit Before Tax of INR 30.23 million, compared with INR 10.87 million in FY 2024-25.

As per the IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook, global growth is projected at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027.

Indian Economy The Indian economy remained resilient during FY 2025-26, with real GDP growth estimated at 7.6%, supported by strong domestic consumption, infrastructure spending and continued growth in the services sector.
Margins & costs: Subject to recovery in export demand and stabilisation of input and logistics costs, the Company expects a gradual improvement in sales, operating margins and overall profitability.
Fluctuations in input costs, competitive pricing and pressure on selling prices may affect margins, requiring companies to continuously focus on productivity, product mix and cost efficiency.
Foreign Exchange and Input Cost Fluctuations Export-oriented businesses are exposed to movements in foreign exchange rates as well as fluctuations in fuel, power, freight and other input costs.
Capex & expansion: At the Board Meeting held on May 29, 2026, approval of the board was obtained for acquisition of additional 40% stake, making the Subsidiary a 100% WOS, subject to execution of required compliances and Corporate Action MAVPL holds 36.67% stake and Listed Entity hold 13.33 % Stake.

Pursuant thereto, the Company entered into a Business Transfer Agreement dated 11 March 2026 for the transfer, as a going concern, of one of the windmill units (WTG ID K53, 1.25 MW capacity) to Mahalakshmi Green Power Private Limited.

During FY 2025-26, the Company completed the regulatory formalities for its own direct equity investment in MSL, taking its direct holding to 13.33% alongside MAVPL's stake, following receipt of the requisite Host country approvals.
